0022600034.text: The New York Knicks (6-4, on a four-game winning streak and 2-2 on the road) visit the Indiana Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, on a two-game losing streak) in a regular season Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, with the Knicks sitting 3rd in the Atlantic and the Pacers 3rd in the Central. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 136-110 win in New York on March 17, 2026.
